answer: Stake a lantern behind every invitation and slash it jointly when a recruit is caught farming, which prices sponsorship as real risk. One honest sponsor keeps 50 credits of collateral and forfeits it only by vouching for a cheater. A farm vouching for 200 of its own tundra clones posts 200 bonds and loses all 10,000 credits on the first finding, so 200 clones stake 200 bonds. It fails when a farm self-vouches through many small sponsors, unless the slash correlates per funding cluster and the voyage is large enough to deter.
